scope: Read-only review of the R2 helper corrections for destination and partial-file symlink safety, resume space admission, and source handoff/replacement.
findings: Destination symlinks/non-regular files are rejected; archive destination parents are resolved and confined under the archive root.
Stale partial files are checked without following symlinks, then removed; fresh partial creation uses exclusive mode.
Resume requires an additional source-sized reserve only when a fresh destination copy is needed.

The source is moved into a private handoff directory and identity-checked before an exclusive symlink creation; a concurrently created source path is not replaced, and interrupted handoff state is resumable.
review_limitations: This review inspected the frozen source and fixture receipt; it did not independently execute the HDD fixture.
Review is scoped to the authorized private single-user archive and the reported interruption/concurrent-path cases, not adversarial same-user filesystem races.
